description:
Is the Taal Volcano eruption a Bible prophecy event? Pastor Mark Finley shares what the Bible says about end time events and signs of the second coming of Christ. 

The Taal Volcano in the Philippines erupted January 12 and 13 causing destruction when it spewed hot ash and smoke to the surrounding area. Does the Bible have to say about events like these? Is this a sign or prophetic event?  Pastor Mark Finley responds to these questions to give an understanding as to how natural disasters fit into a Biblical perspective.
